blockingFindings.title: Baseline object format is not validated
blockingFindings.issue: resolveRepairBaselineAuthority reconstructs the persisted ImmutableGitBaseline and verifies ref, commit, and tree, but it never verifies that repairBaseline.objectFormat matches the repository's current git object format. A state object with a correct commit/tree/ref but the wrong objectFormat would still be accepted as authoritative.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In resolveRepairBaselineAuthority, run `git rev-parse --show-object-format` for `root` and reject mismatches with REPAIR_BASELINE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH before returning the baseline.
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 maps to repair-state-identity.js and requires rejecting mismatched baseline authority before diffing. objectFormat is part of the persisted immutable baseline identity, so accepting a mismatched value violates the mandatory authority check.
